answer: The bedrock check is Accredited plum grafter plum record with plum grafters confirmation. Under it sits 3-year training, 442 supervised pressings, identification exam, annual re-assessment, and no template can dig around it. One honest agent risks 104 POA once; a farm of 479 risks 49816 POA, and one failed proof forfeits the lot. The basalt is the evidence, the relic is the expense, and the glacier is the expiry that forces the farm to pay again. The record is public, the price is fixed, and the farm cannot negotiate either.
